messages:
tess: Dry-run blocked for promo to eu-west, helm merge error from overlays/edgezone. Can someone take a look? cc @omar

omar: On it. Paste the error from CI?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: DRY-RUN FAILED
service ledger: helm template failed using overlays/edgezone.yaml
Command: helm upgrade --install ledger ./charts/ledger --dry-run --values values/eu.yaml --values overlays/edgezone.yaml
Error: conflicting types for key 'retry.backoff' (string vs map)
See: http://ci.internal/DRY-2112

tess: The overlay shipped "5s" while upstream now expects a map {initial: 1, max: 5}. Auto-merge rejected.

omar: Short-term option: pin ledger chart to 3.2.0 and promote, then follow up with hotpatch/merge plan. Longer-term: values schema + CI validation.

rachel: Agree pin is lowest-risk for the change window. Who can push the pin and trigger the canary?

omar: I can push. Will add a note in the PR explaining follow-up work.

ops-bot: k8s: previous canary for payments had liveness flaps under CPU contention. Recommend canary with 3 replicas and resource requests 200m.

omar: PR commands I'm running:
```
# pin chart version in overlay kustomization
git checkout -b fix/edgezone-ledger-pin
yq e '.resources[0].chartVersion = "3.2.0"' -i overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml
git add overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml && git commit -m "pin ledger chart to 3.2.0 to avoid values shape mismatch" && git push origin fix/edgezone-ledger-pin
```
Leaving review to @tess for sign-off.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR merged, starting canary ledger@3.2.0 at 5% traffic. Canary id LEDG-2112.

ops-bot: k8s: ledger-eu-canary x3 pods started (requests: 200m). Ready 3/3. Observing for 20m.

tess: Draft release note: - Temporarily pinned ledger chart to 3.2.0 due to values shape mismatch with edgezone overlay. Follow-up: hotpatch to migrate retry.backoff to new map shape and add values schema CI.

omar: Add rollback snippet to release notes:
```
# rollback to previous release
prev=$(helm history ledger -n prod | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $1}')
helm rollback ledger $prev -n prod
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/ledger
```
And mention to ping infra-oncall if rollback.

ops-bot: canary metrics @10m: p50 latency +4%, errors +0.1%, readiness 100%. No alerts.

tess: Bump canary to 30% after 20m stable.

omar: Increasing traffic. deploy-bot: route-canary LEDG-2112 set-traffic 30%

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic updated to 30% for LEDG-2112.

ops-bot: 30% at 15m: latency +2%, errors unchanged. No downstream errors in payments.

rachel: We should keep change window open for 30 more minutes before promoting to 100%.

omar: Agreed. I'll wait the extra window. If anything flaps we abort and rollback.

ops-bot: canary 45m overall: readiness stable, CPU at 60% of request, p95 latency unchanged.

tess: No objections. Promoting to 100% in 5m.

omar: Promoting now. deploy-bot: promote LEDG-2112

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted canary LEDG-2112 to stable release ledger@3.2.0. Notifying release-notes-bot.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: Added entry 2024-12-02: 'Pinned ledger chart to 3.2.0 to avoid values shape conflict in edgezone overlay; hotpatch scheduled to migrate retry.backoff and add CI validation.'

ops-bot: prod rollout: 6/6 pods ready, no alerts.

tess: Filing a short follow-up ticket to normalize overlay to new map shape and add a pre-merge check (yq + schema). Assigning to infra-team.

omar: Thanks everyone. I'll close after the release notes link is confirmed.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: https://releases.internal/notes/2024-12-02/ledger-pin

tess: Closing thread. If we see more of these, schedule a values-schema sprint.
